result.summary: The application interface is mostly clean and functional, but there is one minor layout issue regarding the text clipping of the 'Trattoria Piccol...' name.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated/clipped at the end of the text label for the third card in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout to allow more space for the title or implement a dynamic font size reduction to ensure the full name is visible.
